original.summary: Shade colours are non-metallic satin washes for shading the corresponding metallic Base colours.
steps: Apply the corresponding Base colour before shading.
Use Shade colours in recesses and mid-tones to reinforce shadows.
For softer shadow transitions, dilute the Shade colour with water.
tips: Shade colours can be mixed with one another.
